page.overview:
Who is Birdloe?

Lieutenant Birdloe was a male Imperial stormtrooper who served as second-in-command to Captain Sodarra. Birdloe was unfamiliar with the workings of modified freighters such as the Millennium Falcon, lacking both the skills to pilot such a starship and an understanding of their repair. Unbeknownst to Sodarra, Birdloe was a spy for Governor-General Vellam, relaying the Falcon movements to the renegade governor in his hunt for Darth Vader.
